description: Inventory of visual assets used in the Canasta web app.

assets.name: Standard playing card faces (52 cards: 4 suits × 13 ranks) + 1 Joker

files.pdf: assets/full_deck.pdf (53 pages, one card per page)

assets.generation: scripts/generate_card_faces.py — Pillow renderer. Layout: large top-left rank with suit beneath, mirrored 180° bottom-right, single dominant center suit. Style: ultra-bold sans ranks (Segoe UI Black), solid suit glyphs, off-white face, black/red palette.
assets.order: spades A–K, hearts A–K, diamonds A–K, clubs A–K, then joker
assets.license: original work, no third-party assets used, free to use

assets.name: Card faces (runtime SVG fallback)
assets.generation: src/components/Card.tsx — still renders faces on demand from {rank, suit} for in-app play; the PNG set in assets/ is the print/exportable face pack.
assets.license: original work, no third-party assets used, free to use

assets.name: Card back design
assets.generation: src/components/Card.tsx — CardBackFace() renders an original diamond/cross-hatch pattern with a simple monogram.
assets.license: original work, no third-party assets used, free to use

assets.name: App title / logo
assets.type: text + inline SVG cards (no dedicated logo file)
assets.license: original work, no third-party assets used, free to use

assets.name: Player avatars
assets.type: css/svg (colored circle + initials, no image files)
assets.license: original work, no third-party assets used, free to use

assets.name: Felt table background texture
assets.license: original work, no third-party assets used, free to use

notes: No third-party card image sets, icon packs, or stock photography are used.
